data.one_liner: A Flutter data table with sticky headers that loads contents lazily.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter data table widget with optional sticky row and/or column headers that loads contents lazily. It supports scrollable overflowing items, custom sizing for individual columns or rows, and theming.
use_when: You need to display a large grid or table of data that should be loaded lazily
You require sticky row and/or column headers that stay in view while scrolling
avoid_when: You need a standard simple material data table without lazy loading or complex sticky header grids
strengths: Lazy loading of items for performance
Sticky row and column headers that stay in view
Custom sizes for individual columns or rows
weaknesses: Widget is still in development and may not work 100%
data.minimal_example:
LazyDataTable(
  rows: 100,
  columns: 100,
  tableDimensions: LazyDataTableDimensions(
    cellHeight: 50,
    cellWidth: 100,
    topHeaderHeight: 50,
    leftHeaderWidth: 75,
  ),
  topHeaderBuilder: (i) => Center(child: Text("Column: ${i + 1}")),
  leftHeaderBuilder: (i) => Center(child: Text("Row: ${i + 1}")),
  dataCellBuilder: (i, j) => Center(child: Text("Cell: $i, $j")),
  topLeftCornerWidget: Center(child: Text("Corner")),
)
